description:
Drinko helps you make better cocktails at home with classic recipes, bartending tutorials, and a smart cabinet to track ingredients.

Explore 140+ classic cocktail recipes and 40+ shots — from a Negroni and Old Fashioned to a Margarita, Daiquiri, Mojito, and Gin Tonic — learn essential bartending techniques, save your favorites, and see what's already in your home bar and spirits cabinet before you shop.

Make it yours: add your own recipes with a photo, turn it into a sticker. Your favorites and settings sync with your iPhone and iPad with iCloud.

Drinko is built for beginners and cocktail enthusiasts who want to mix with more confidence, improve their technique, and stay organized behind the bar.
whatsNew:
Drinko now works with Siri and Shortcuts on your Mac: hear any recipe read aloud, get today's cocktail, or let Drinko surprise you.

New
• "How do I make a Negroni in Drinko?" Siri reads the ingredients, then the method when you're ready
• Ask for today's cocktail, or say "Surprise me in Drinko"
• Add or remove favorites and restock your Cabinet by voice
• Find cocktails from Spotlight and use every action in the Shortcuts app

Improved
• New recipes and lessons arrive without waiting for an app update, and stay available offline
• Sharing a drink comes with a fresh message each time
